visualReview.notes: Inspected57 current frames:13 portable,13 shared-material/flat-map fixture and31 Earth-rig/tier frames. The two pale inverted-Y pylons, separated cable fans, open navigation span, four carriageway lanes, raised median/barriers, curved twin-arm lights and curved/sloping approach viaducts are coherent. Whole-crossing default context frames are too distant to assess fine detail; authored main-span, pylon, cable, deck, anchorage and approach cameras supply that review. Explicit four-tier cameras retain the crossing while aggregating cables and piers at distance. Shared concrete, aggregate-road and metal graphs use metric UVs without private images. The two bank-side pylons are offset from the full-approach catalog center, following the retained named PMTiles bridge and canal interval. Flat/synthetic rendering fixtures do not prove native terrain fit. Coarse standard terrain samples guide end grades; unsurveyed abutments, foundations and bank contact, regularized approach pier spacing, reconstructed cable/furniture dimensions and estimated LOD errors remain explicit.
